actions.impersonation_ended: Went back from signing in as a user
actions.request_subscribers_changed: Changed a request’s subscribers while signed in as a user
actions.staff_renamed: Changed the name shown to users

events.sessionsRevokedMfaRequired: Signed out of sessions without MFA, which the role now requires
events.mfaFailedAtSignIn: Wrong two-step verification code entered at sign-in
events.passwordCheckFailedChangePassword: Wrong current password entered when changing the password
events.passwordCheckFailedDeactivate: Wrong current password entered when deactivating the account
events.passwordCheckFailedEnableTwoFactor: Wrong current password entered when turning on two-step verification
events.passwordCheckFailedDisableTwoFactor: Wrong current password entered when turning off two-step verification
events.passwordCheckFailedBackupCodes: Wrong current password entered when creating new backup codes
events.impersonationExpired: Sign-in as a user ended when its time was up
events.impersonationNoLongerAllowed: Sign-in as a user ended because it was no longer allowed
events.impersonationSessionEnded: Sign-in as a user ended with the staff member’s own session
events.inviteLinkClaimUndone: Invite link made usable again because its email couldn’t be sent
events.memberJoinedKept: Used an invitation and kept the role they had
events.webhookTurnedOffFailing: Webhook turned off after its deliveries failed for days
events.webhookTurnedOffGone: Webhook turned off because its receiver is gone
events.webhookTurnedOffUnreadable: Webhook turned off because its address or secret can’t be read
